caption: The drawing depicts a figurine of a seated human figure on a rounded, rectangular plinth. The figure wears a light gray dress decorated with red, green, and yellow patterns along the edges, wrists, collar, and hem. The figure also wears a yellow hat with a green band, infused with red accents, and has short brown hair visible beneath the brim. The figurine's skin is colored light gray with subtle shading to suggest three-dimensionality. The eyes are outlined in dark gray or black, and the lips are red. The left hand of the figure is placed on the chest, while the right rests on the lap, both hands colored light gray with slight shadowing. The feet are bare and rest on the base, which is decorated with simple, engraved geometric designs. The whole object is centrally positioned within a rectangular border drawn close to the edges of the paper, and the background is left plain beige.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Shepherd Boy
